description: This file defines the main activity for a media browsing Android application, specifically for a music player. It manages fragment transactions based on media item selections and interfaces with media controls.

classes.name: MusicPlayerActivity
classes.description: Main activity for the media browser music player, handling UI setup and media item selection.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and adds the root fragment if none exists.

methods.name: onMediaItemSelected
methods.description: Handles media item selection; plays media if playable, or browses media if browsable.
